page.overview:
Who is Flash Baylor?

Flash Baylor is a player for the Springfield Isotopes. He is a washed up major leaguer who plays for the 'Topes. In the episode, Bart tries to get him to sign a ball, but Baylor refuses. Bart is disappointed, so Marge grabs the ball and gets Baylor to sign it. He writes "Springfield Kozy Kourt Motel, Room 26, How about it?" Homer proclaims "Wow! Flash Baylor came onto my wife!"
